title: Synthetic demo · broken shelf and worn paint
lease: The tenant must pay reasonable documented repair costs for damage caused by the tenant beyond ordinary wear. Ordinary wear and pre-existing damage are not deductible. Replacement must not improve the original condition.
inspection: Synthetic check-in report, agreed by both parties: bedroom shelf intact; hallway paint already scuffed. Synthetic check-out report, agreed by both parties: bedroom shelf broken; hallway paint has similar scuffs.
